message.description: Message of the incident, limited to 130 characters.

description.description: A detailed description of the incident.

responders.description: Teams that the incident is routed to for response.

type.description: Type of responder, must be team.

tags.description: Tags to attach to the incident.

details.description: Custom key-value pairs to attach to the incident.

priority.description: Priority level of the incident. P1 is the highest.

impactedServices.description: List of service IDs that are impacted by the incident.

statusPageEntry.description: Status page entry to create with the incident.

title.description: Title of the status page entry.

detail.description: Detail message for the status page entry.

notifyStakeholders.description: Whether to send notifications to stakeholders.
